how to get back on track
after falling behind in school

1. make one list of everything you missed

it looks scary on paper.
but now it has an end.

2. talk to your teacher this week

they'd rather help now
than see you fail later.

3. catch up on the newest topic first

tomorrow's class builds on it.
the old stuff can wait a few days.

4. borrow notes from the best note-taker

and offer them a coffee.
it's a fair trade.

5. make learning feel good again

before, school felt like a mountain i couldn't climb.
now i learn one fun thing every morning. and studying feels lighter.
